messages:
jamie-infra: Ping @zenith-ops. We have a customer with 10 H100s that need to go into APAC cluster next week. Where are our allocation/ETAs? Will need RMA staging for 2 DOAs.
zenith-ops: Jamie — current allocation: 8 confirmed for APAC dock 3 by 03/15, 4 in backlog that could ship 03/22. Customs backlog in SG/TW adding ~4-7 days. For DOA we can pre-stage replacements but need AWBs and serials.
jamie-infra: We need 10 by 03/18 for a canary — any way to expedite 2 units via air? What's incremental cost?
finance-ops: Estimate for air expedite (door-to-door) for 2 units: +$18k per unit vs sea. Insurance +$1k unit. Total breakout in spreadsheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/apac-expedite (shared).
zenith-ops: We can do 2 air-express out of SG with priority customs paperwork. Will require CC auth and deposit. Also need pre-filled RMA labels for depot in SIN (Depot-SIN-A).
operations: Note: depot SIN-A accepts pre-registered serials only. Please send serials to depot@logistics with subject 'pre-reg H100'. If not pre-reg they'll quarantine 48-72h.
jamie-infra: We'll push serials today. Also, for the 2 DOA returns, do we do swap-in-the-box or collect for depot repair?
zenith-ops: Swap-in-the-box (SITB) is available in SG. For partial swaps we need to confirm warranty coverage on those SKUs — vendor PO shows standard 12 month. SITB AWB template:
```
AWB: TBD123456789
Pickup: SG-HUB
Consignee: Redwood Depot SIN-A
Service: Express
```
leo-support: I'll open the RMA case and attach the eval logs. RMA ticket L-4567 created. @logistics-bot please attach ETA once AWB issued.
logistics-bot: Ticket L-4567 created. Reminder: include proof-of-ownership and purchase invoice to avoid customs hold.
jamie-infra: :thumbsup: sending serial list now. One more Q — if customs holds, can we route to regional pool in TW as fallback?
zenith-ops: Yes — TW depot (TPE-B) can accept overflow but leadtime +2 days for inter-APAC transfer and extra handling fee ~$500/unit. We'll mark routing policy 'APAC-primary, fallback-TW' in manifest.
jamie-infra: Thanks — proceeding with CC auth. Will post AWBs when issued.
